we have solved the structure of a nonstop complex, in which a ribosome has stalled at the end of the mRNA, and the ribosome is rescued by ArfA and RF2.

ArfA substitutes for a missing stop codon by directly interacting with release factor 2 and inducing a conformational change in it, which is similar to the one that occurs when RF2 binds to a stop codon in a canonical ribosome–mRNA complex.
